title: A Pseudorandom Correlation Function from Sparse LPN Secure Against Subexponentially Many Queries
statement_paraphrase: That a strong PCF for subfield VOLE from sparse LPN exists supporting 2^{lambda^epsilon} queries with 2^{-lambda^epsilon} advantage, in the random oracle model.

queries_run: pseudorandom correlation function sparse LPN subexponential queries standard model weak PCF 2026 follow-up

evidence.claim: The source's PCF from sparse LPN is secure only up to n^(log n/log log n) queries, superpolynomial not subexponential, and the random oracle is inherent because random-oracle inputs overlap across PCF queries. Both open questions stand as posed.
evidence.citation: Braun, Couteau, Melissaris, Riahinia, Sadeghi, Fast Pseudorandom Correlation Functions from Sparse LPN, ASIACRYPT 2025

evidence.claim: The one follow-up construction from sparse LPN (Hasler and Reisert, multiparty Beaver triples) inherits the same superpolynomial ceiling and the same random oracle.
